jobs.description:
At Qred, we’re building the world’s best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, and following our merger with Liberis, we’re now a global group generating over €300 million in annual revenue and serving more than 100,000 small businesses across 17 countries in Europe and North America. Together, we combine a regulated, deposit-funded bank with an embedded finance network of partners, using smart technology, real-time data and human judgment to make financing simple, fast and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets and currencies, we’re now looking for a Commercial Manager to strengthen our Card function for the next phase of growth.
About the Role
In this role, you will hold end-to-end commercial ownership of our rapidly scaling business card P&L. You bridge rigorous technical execution with commercial impact, using modern financial systems and advanced AI tooling to transform raw performance data into actionable business decisions.
Key responsibilities
Track portfolio performance against forecast targets across markets, proactively diagnosing root causes behind variance for key stakeholders.

Model unit economics and P&L drivers - including revenue streams, acquisition costs, and credit losses - to identify high-impact margin opportunities.

Define and optimize core commercial levers such as feature pricing, partner commission frameworks, and loyalty program economics.

Align cross-functional initiatives across Product, Credit Strategy, and Finance to implement performance improvements and quantify business outcomes.

Embed modern AI agents into daily research, financial modeling, and data analysis workflows to elevate operational scaling.

What we’re looking for
You bring a highly structured, analytical mindset and an instinct for resolving ambiguous business problems with quantitative clarity. You drive alignment effortlessly across disciplines, communicate complex metrics concisely to leadership, and are motivated to build scalable commercial frameworks in a high-velocity environment.
Qualifications
Several years of experience across commercial strategy, business development, partnerships, or commercial finance within fintech, payments, lending, or regulated financial services.

Proven track record of owning end-to-end partner terms, contract negotiations, and long-term commercial relationship management.

Strong expertise in building financial models from scratch, with deep command of unit economics, lifetime value (CLV), and P&L dynamics.

Daily fluency using AI agents for data querying, financial modeling, and analysis, paired with the critical judgment to audit their outputs.

Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Why us?
This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

At Scala, we offer market-leading software for Digital In-store experiences. Scala works with forward-thinking brands, such as Volvo, M&S, J.Lindeberg, and Uniqlo. From our offices in Sweden, Norway, US and the UK, we enable our partners and their customers to design and implement unique Digital In-store solutions. Scala is part of the Vertiseit Group, listed on the Nasdaq First North Growth Market in Sweden.
Are you looking for an opportunity to thrive in a forward-thinking product company with a strong team spirit?
Scala is expanding and is now looking for a DevOps to join our team in Varberg.
The Role
As a DevOps at Scala, you will play a central role in building and maintaining the infrastructure and pipelines that power our software platform for Digital In-store experiences.
You will ensure that our development and delivery processes are efficient, reliable, and scalable, enabling our teams to move fast without compromising quality or stability.
In this role, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain robust DevOps pipelines and infrastructure to support scalable, secure, and high-performing applications.

Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.

Collaborate closely with developers to streamline code deployment, enhance automation, and improve system performance.

Drive continuous improvement in DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and security posture across environments.

Operate and maintain our existing infrastructure based on Node.js, NGINX, and Azure, including virtual servers hosted in co-location.

Monitor, deploy, and update systems using Octopus Deploy, Azure CLI, and Bicep.

Support migration efforts from Bitbucket to GitHub, including repositories and CI/CD pipelines.

Create and manage build pipelines in TeamCity and Jenkins, ensuring version control and deployment efficiency.

Set up and optimize developer environments in GitHub and other tools to boost productivity and collaboration.

Who You Are
We are looking for a hands-on and curious DevOps professional who enjoys working in a collaborative environment. You are passionate about automation, scalable systems, and creating smooth developer experiences.
To succeed in this role, you have:
Several years of hands-on experience in DevOps, system engineering, or cloud infrastructure.
Solid knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure or AWS.
Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar.
Strong experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform, …).
A solid understanding of networking, monitoring, and security best practices.
Fluent proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.
Nice to have:
Experience working in SaaS or product development environments.
Familiarity with .NET environments and modern web architectures.
Background in software development with a DevOps mindset.
Why Join Scala?
We offer an inclusive work environment where you will be surrounded by skilled and passionate colleagues.

Well-being first – Enjoy health initiatives and a generous wellness allowance.

Team spirit & fun – We believe in having fun together and organizing activities to create great memories.

Learn & grow – Work alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment.

Job security & benefits – At Scala, we offer a collective agreement to ensure fair working conditions.

Career opportunities – We invest in internal career paths and development opportunities to help you grow with us.

Warrants program

Practical Information
📍 Location: Full-time position at our office in Varberg. 📅 Application deadline: 27th November (We recruit on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible!)
If you have any questions please contact johanna.lindholm@dise.com

Are you a Verification Engineer looking for your next opportunity within product development? Join our growing and dedicated V&V team, where you will play a key role to ensure that our developed systems fulfil customer expectations.
We are looking for two Verification Engineers to join our Verification and Validation (V&V) team within R&D. The V&V team is responsible for testing, verification and validation of systems both during product development and within the product care process. The systems entail hardware, software and often a consumable, e.g. a column for separation.
As a driven Verification Engineer with a technical interest, you ensure product quality and efficiency throughout the product life cycle. You will work as a test and verification lead within the project teams to develop new instruments. The role involves networking with internal stakeholders and working as part of a multidisciplinary team to deliver the highest quality products and processes.
Improvements to our existing product portfolio are also an important part of the role. You will independently run small projects and improvement initiatives, taking a hands-on approach to implement changes that enhance our products.
Key responsibilities:
Perform, report and lead our test, verification and validation activities for systems which entail hardware, software and consumables.

Define and evaluate system requirements and the corresponding test cases.

Conduct technical investigations, including risk assessments and root-cause analyses.

Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulatory guidelines.

Actively contribute to continuous improvement of processes and practices within V&V.

Collaborate with peers to troubleshoot issues, optimize performance, and ensure timely delivery of tasks.

Fostering a positive and collaborative work environment.

Education and Experience:
BSc/MSc in Systems, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering or similar

Preferably 2+ years of experience within verification, validation or testing

Previous experience from product development or quality assurance

Experience in creating and maintaining plans

Experience as a verification, test or project lead

Experience in requirement management and risk management

Experience from a controlled business or good documentation practice from elsewhere

Knowledge in regulatory framework applicable for laboratory equipment (e.g Low Voltage Directive LVD and Machinery Directive MD) is a merit

Desired skills and qualities:
You have strong problem-solving skills and enjoy collaborating with others to achieve high-quality results.

You are a driven, independent and curious individual.

You have a technical interest and are comfortable with hands-on laboratory work.

You have a strong focus on quality and understand the importance of product life-cycle management.

You have a structured approach to your work.

You are fluent in both written and spoken English and Swedish.

What we offer:
Biotage offers an innovative, collaborative and productive work environment where you work and learn with stakeholders in regional marketing, R&D, supply chain, the global service team and customer support, to deliver the very best products and processes. As a valued Verification Engineer, you will be an essential part of Biotage R&D, liaising with and reporting to the Director of Verification & Validation, based at Biotage Headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden.
About Biotage:
Biotage is a global supplier and solutions partner to a wide range of customers within drug discovery and development and analytical testing. With strong expertise in separation and purification technologies, and a focus on leveraging intelligent workflow solutions, we aim to efficiently support the advancement and protection of human health. Learn more at biotage.com

Company description:
Volvo
Job description: 
 Head of Maintenance Volvo Powertrain Industrial Skövde 
Volvo Powertrain Industrial in Skövde is undergoing a historic transformation as we develop and begin producing tomorrow’s sustainable powertrains. At the same time, we continue to manufacture world-class engines. To succeed in this transformation, we need a maintenance organisation that delivers high reliability today while developing to meet future needs.
 We are now looking for a Head of Maintenance to lead and develop the organisation through this change. We are looking not only for an experienced maintenance leader, but for a results-oriented transformation leader who can engage people, challenge established ways of working and build a strong culture characterised by both Dare and Care.
 Who are you? 
A present and inclusive leader, you bring people together in a clear direction and create the trust and engagement needed to deliver results. You understand the connection between people, ways of working and results, and know that sustainable improvements are achieved together with the organisation. You will encourage fresh thinking, and not just rely on established practices, drive change, while showing care and creating psychological safety.
 Experienced in leading through other leaders, you build alignment across the organisation and make complex topics easy to understand. Your communication helps people see why change matters and how they can contribute. When obstacles arise, with a structured and persistent approach you keep focus on the target, the gap, root causes, clear priorities and improvements that deliver results. Following up on progress, giving regular feedback and celebrating successes are all important parts of how you lead.
 The assignment
 You will join the Skövde management team, report to the Head of Skövde plant, and play a central role in developing the business strategy and advancing initiatives that strengthen the entire production site. Volvo’s site in Skövde includes a foundry, machining and engine assembly, hub production and other components, as well as the manufacture of battery modules, battery packs and battery energy storage systems. In this role your heading an organisation of approximately 600 employees together with four department managers and several production leaders across the respective functions.
 Together with your management team, you will continue the journey of developing maintenance from reactive interventions towards a more planned, preventive and data-driven approach. By understanding and addressing root causes, you and the organisation will contribute to greater reliability, improved availability and more efficient production flows. You will drive the development of maintenance strategies, processes, competence and ways of working. This also includes developing the use of data and AI to plan and prioritize maintenance activities, monitor results and predict failures.
 The role involves close collaboration with Production, Engineering and other functions. You will have overall responsibility for ensuring that maintenance contributes to safety, quality, production performance, budget and continuous improvement.
  
  
 Your ticket to ride  A Master of Science in Engineering or equivalent experience considered relevant by the employer.
 Several years of experience in manufacturing or process industries, together with a good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, reliability and systematic improvement.
 A proven track record of successful leadership in maintenance, engineering or production.
 Experience leading through managers and developing large organisations.
 Experience in change management and in developing ways of working, organisations and culture.
 The ability to use data and relevant performance measures to set priorities, monitor progress and deliver results.
 Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across functions and organisational boundaries.
 The ability to communicate effectively in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.

jobs.occupation: The Swedish House of Finance (SHoF) is looking for an Executive Director
jobs.description:
Introduction
The Swedish House of Finance (SHoF) at the Stockholm School of Economics is Sweden's national center for financial research and an internationally oriented environment for research, knowledge exchange and societal relevance. SHoF brings together prominent researchers in financial economics and creates meeting places where academia, the financial sector and public decision makers can exchange knowledge, challenge established perspectives and develop new ideas.
As Executive Director of SHoF, you will have a central role in leading and further developing this business. The role combines strategic leadership with clear operational responsibility and offers great opportunities to influence how SHoF develops, is visible and creates value. You will work closely with some of Sweden's and the world's leading researchers in financial economics and at the same time have extensive contacts with the financial sector and other key societal actors.
Main responsibilities
The leadership of SHoF is shared between two people: Director and Executive Director. The Director is responsible for ensuring that SHoF's activities are academically relevant and of high scientific quality, while the Executive Director leads and distributes the work and has budget, personnel and work environment responsibility. The Executive Director is a full-time position located in Stockholm.
The Executive Director is responsible for ensuring that the business is managed in accordance with the Board's instructions. This includes, among other things, to
prepare the matters to be dealt with at the meetings of the Board of Directors
analyze issues of strategic and organizational importance
lead and distribute the work in the business
ensure that the business complies with relevant laws and regulations
ensure the long-term financing of the business
represent SHoF towards external stakeholders (together with the Director)

Tasks
The Executive Director shall take the measures necessary to ensure that the business is managed in an appropriate, efficient and satisfactory manner. This includes, among other things, to
implement decisions made by the board
recruit the necessary staff
sign the necessary agreements (in ongoing matters)
ensure the planning, budgeting, monitoring and reporting of operations
be responsible for the contact with the Stockholm School of Economics and other academic partners and coordinate relevant processes with these

Requirements profile
SHoF is a small organization with short decision-making paths and limited internal support functions, operating at the intersection of academia, policy and the financial sector. The Executive Director is therefore expected to understand and work effectively within an academic environment, but must also be able to interact with decision-makers in both the private and public financial sectors. The work includes handling a wide range of strategic, operational and administrative issues, which is why it is a requirement that the applicant has
experience of previous management roles
good administrative skills
ability to work independently
ability to prioritize and create structure in a creative (and sometimes chaotic) environment
a relevant academic degree
a strong interest in financial economics
good knowledge of English

In addition, the successful applicant should
be flexible and unpretentious
have experience in fundraising
be a good communicator
have experience from academic activities

Application
The deadline for applications is November 20, 2026; however, selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. Welcome to apply here: https://pnty-apply.ponty-system.se/lagerpartners?id=1969 . If you have any questions about the position, please contact Lager & Partners’ consultant, Niclas Näslund, at 08-407 64 60.

The Opportunity
As power systems become increasingly complex, utilities and grid operators rely on advanced SCADA solutions to monitor and control their networks. At Hitachi Energy, you will join a global team delivering these solutions to customers around the world, supporting the reliable operation of critical power infrastructures.
As a SCADA Engineer you will work closely with customers, project teams, and technical specialists throughout the full project lifecycle, from solution design and system configuration to testing, commissioning, and deployment. You'll combine technical expertise, problem-solving, and collaboration to deliver high quality solutions that meet operational and business requirements.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys working with complex systems, solving technical challenges, and collaborating with stakeholders in an international project environment.
How you’ll make an impact
Act as a technical expert for SCADA functionality within Network Manager projects.
Configure and implement SCADA applications and support system infrastructure.
Translate customer operational requirements into effective SCADA solutions.
Support system migrations, integrations, and data exchange between connected systems.
Validate delivered solutions through testing, commissioning, and customer acceptance activities.
Collaborate with customers and project teams throughout the full project lifecycle.
Strengthen engineering practices: contribute to continuous improvements and knowledge sharing across the SCADA engineering team.

Your Background
Bachelor's degree in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automation or equivalent. A Master’s degree is highly regarded.
Experience with SCADA systems, industrial automation, or industrial control environments.
Understanding of power systems, including generation, transmission, and distribution systems.
Familiarity with industry standards and protocols including OPC UA, ICCP, and ISO/IEC standards related to SCADA.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail when working with SCADA configurations and data models.
Strong communication skills with the ability to gather and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions.
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required. Swedish language skills are preferred.
The role includes occasional travel, with mobility requirements of up to 20% depending on business needs and project activities.

jobs.occupation: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark's power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installations
You will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

-Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

-Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

-Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

-Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

-Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibility
You are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

-Works independently and takes a structured approach

-Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

-Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

-Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

-Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call duties
At Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish "fritvalgsordning" scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from you
If this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

TL;DR
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Security at Lovable, end-to-end, from conception through rollout. You'll make sure the millions of apps built on Lovable are safe, trustworthy, and secure by default, turning security from a checkbox into a genuine product differentiator.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
8+ years in the software industry, with exposure to security, trust & safety, or platform integrity in a product management or engineering leadership role
Familiarity with the security challenges unique to AI-generated software, including code vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and unsafe defaults, and how to build secure-by-default experiences users don't have to think about
Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on threat models, vulnerabilities, and platform architecture
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You know how to translate security constraints into good user experiences rather than friction, and you have sharp opinions on when security should be invisible vs. unmistakable
Preferred: Prior experience working on platform security or trust & safety at scale; familiarity with enterprise security requirements and how they influence product decisions

What you'll do
Represent the user. Bring findings on security posture, threat models, and trust signals to the team with clarity and conviction
Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and crafting security messaging that resonates with both technical and non-technical users
Shape how security surfaces across the product, spanning AI output review, permissions, publishing safeguards, and vulnerability detection
Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't
Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to speak credibly about security, especially for enterprise buyers where it's a dealbreaker
Projects you'll tackle first: Mapping the current threat surface across Lovable-generated apps and defining the biggest gaps; owning the first iteration of secure-by-default publishing safeguards; building the internal framework for how security features get scoped, prioritized, and communicated across the company

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realize amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Working at the heart of major business opportunities, you will lead the daily operations of the Bid Centre and create the conditions for successful proposal development across multiple campaigns and customer opportunities.
The role is focused on coordinating and developing the overall bid capability and supporting bid teams throughout the organization.

You will work closely with Bid Managers, Proposal Managers, campaign teams and stakeholders across Saab, ensuring that resources, methods and tools are used effectively and that our bid teams are equipped to deliver high-quality proposals.
Your responsibility spans four main areas:
Bid Centre Coordination - Coordinating resources, priorities and activities across ongoing bids and campaigns.
Operational Excellence - Supporting the continuous development of methods, processes and tools that strengthen our bid capability.
Business Support - Providing guidance and support to bid teams and contributing to successful proposal delivery across the organization.
Security - Ensuring security plans, physical and digital environment are compliant with governing regulations.

Your profile
We are looking for a driven and structured professional who thrives in a complex international business environment. You enjoy creating clarity, bringing people together around a common objective and ensuring that activities move forward in an efficient and coordinated way.

To succeed in this role, we see that you:
Have experience of coordinating projects, bids or other complex business activities.
Have strong collaborative and communication skills.
Are comfortable working across organizational boundaries and engaging with a wide range of stakeholders.
Have excellent organizational skills and a structured, proactive way of working.

Enjoy improving ways of working and creating efficient processes.
Have a "doer" mindset and take ownership from idea to execution.
Are fluent in English and Swedish.

Have curiosity and openness to technological development, with an interest in AI-based tools and methods.

Additionally, the following skills are valued:
Strong communicative skills with ability to convey complex information clearly.
Understanding of risk management in complex business environments.
Aspirational mindset with potential to grow into other roles in sales.
Overall perspective with responsibility to coordinate bids and ensure all plans are up to date.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of
Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here

Join us in our mission to electrify the world for a greener future!
At Senior Material, we are currently seeking a dedicated and analytical Operations Analysis Engineer to join our growing team. If you are passionate about data-driven decision-making, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, this opportunity is for you!
WHO ARE WE?
We work every day to electrify the world for a greener future. Through a thin plastic film – more precisely, a separator film – we help make lithium-ion batteries durable and safe. It is one of the key components ensuring the optimal performance of batteries.
Founded in 2003 in Shenzhen, China, Senior Material has been driven by innovation since the very beginning.
Since 2021, we have established our European headquarters in Eskilstuna, Sweden. Here, we are developing one of Europe's most modern production facilities, contributing to the electrification of transportation.
We have an exciting journey ahead of us, and now you have the opportunity to be part of it!

ABOUT THE ROLE:
As an Operations Analysis Engineer at Senior Material, you will play an important role in monitoring and analyzing operational performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization.
You will be responsible for analyzing production performance, maintaining operational KPIs, preparing management reports, and supporting capacity and cost optimization.
Working closely with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and other departments, you will contribute to improving operational efficiency, productivity, and overall business performance.
In summary, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and continuous improvement within our Operations department!
 Job Responsibilities
- Monitor and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), including production output, capacity utilization, yield, scrap, downtime, and delivery performance.
- Develop and maintain operational dashboards, performance reports, and data analysis tools to support management decisions.
- Analyze operational data to identify trends, performance deviations, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
- Support production capacity planning, workforce planning, inventory management, and operational cost analysis.
- Evaluate operational efficiency and cost drivers, providing recommendations to improve productivity and reduce operational costs.
- Ensure the accuracy and consistency of operational data across different reporting systems and departments.
- Collaborate with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and HSE teams to support operational improvements and business objectives.
- Monitor the implementation of improvement initiatives and evaluate their operational and financial results.
- Support the optimization and automation of reporting processes to improve data accuracy and reporting efficiency.
- Follow company policies, quality standards, and health, safety, and environmental requirements.

 Job Competence Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Statistics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Previous experience in operations analysis, production performance analysis, or a similar analytical role, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex operational data and provide practical recommendations.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with ERP systems, reporting tools, or BI dashboards.
- Knowledge of production KPIs, capacity planning, operational efficiency, and cost analysis.
- Experience with SQL, Power BI, or reporting automation is considered an advantage.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to work.
- Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different departments.
- Good command of English, both written and spoken.
- A proactive mindset, willingness to learn, and a strong interest in continuous improvement.

Scope and Impact
You are an autonomous contributor holding end-to-end stewardship accountability for an assigned scope, on behalf of the business owners of that data. You balance stewardship responsibilities, analytics delivery, and self-service enablement while maximizing business value from data through trusted metrics, high-quality data products, and adoption of analytical solutions.
You may sit within a regional IT organization or directly within the business domain, depending on structure.
As a domain resource, you receive governance standards, tooling, and escalation support from the central Data & AI Governance function, Global Data & AI Platform team and the visualization engineering CoE.

What you do
Metrics & Data Products
Align existing and new metric definitions across teams so everyone works from the same numbers.
Curate metric definitions, metadata, and the semantic layer so they're reliable enough for AI agents to answer business questions directly, not just for human dashboard users.
Act as Data Steward for all data products within your assigned sub-domain.
Monitor and improve data quality through controls and remediation activities, elevating data quality and data management from source to the analytical layer.
Maintain metadata, data lineage, business glossaries, and ownership information within the enterprise data catalog.
Track and demonstrate the business value and ROI realized from the data products you steward, using this evidence to prioritize improvements or retirement.
Partner with Data Engineers to define the semantic layer in the global data and AI platform and understand how they built data models and pipelines.
Review and coordinate data access approvals and stewardship workflows in accordance with governance policies and business ownership responsibilities.

Analytical Solutions
Support business stakeholders with complex, non-standard analytical questions that go beyond self-service, applying analytical rigor to validate findings before they inform decisions.
Drive adoption of self-service analytics developed with data engineers.
Build and maintain complex dashboards and analytical solutions.
Validate that self-service and analytical outputs remain accurate when consumed by AI agents, not only by human users.

Data Literacy 
Take ownership for growing data literacy within your sub-domain.
Train and support business users on self-service analytics solutions

AI-readiness & Ways of Working 
Proactively automates routine parts of their own workflow (quality checks, documentation updates, recurring reporting) using agentic AI, and prototypes solutions live with business stakeholders using AI instead of running a traditional multi-week build cycle.

Where you will be
This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
 
Benefits highlights
Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 

 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.occupation: R&D Scientist  Analytics & IoT for Power Systems
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Innovation is at the core of Hitachi Energy, and our research centers are the backbone of our technology development. For our research center in Västerås, Sweden, we are looking for an R&D Scientist with expertise in data‑driven monitoring, diagnostics, and IoT solutions for power systems.
In this role, you will work in highly skilled, collaborative teams with access to state‑of‑the‑art laboratory and experimental facilities, contributing to technologies that enable a more sustainable and resilient energy system.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Identify technical requirements and drive innovation for future sustainable energy systems
Develop and deliver solutions to complex technical challenges within R&D projects
Validate new concepts through laboratory and field testing, including measurements, signal processing, and data analysis, and optimize solutions to meet technical and performance requirements
Manage R&D projects or work packages with a structured approach, clear targets, and effective technical leadership
Create ideas and proposals for R&D projects aligned with business needs and future commercial potential
Collaborate and communicate actively with team members, customers, suppliers, and partners in industry and academia
Deliver results in the form of software, hardware, technical reports, patent applications, scientific publications, and presentations
Build a strong internal network and actively share knowledge and expertise across the organization

Your Background
Preferably PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Proven research experience related to digital substation equipment and architecture
Multidisciplinary knowledge in related areas such as IoT, communication and network architecture, and software development
Hands‑on programming experience, ideally across multiple programming languages
Knowledge and hands‑on experience in both classical and data‑driven signal processing and analysis techniques; experience in algorithm development is an advantage
Previous experience in leading R&D projects or work packages is an advantage
A curious mindset with the ability to adapt quickly to new technical challenges
Excellent communication skills and a strong team‑player attitude
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

What We Offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working hours
Health care and wellness allowance
Excellent career opportunities within Hitachi Energy, both in Sweden and globally
Dedicated mentorship support during the onboarding phase
Continuous training and professional development opportunities
A diverse and inclusive workplace, with over 70 nationalities represented in Sweden
Supplementary compensation during parental leave
Access to an employee benefit portal with a wide range of discounts and perks

More About Us
Are you ready for a new and exciting challenge? Does this role sound like you? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.
For questions about the position, please contact the Recruiting Manager, Md Tanbhir Hoq (md-tanbhir.hoq1@hitachienergy.com).
Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Jonas Hedberg    +46 (10) 7380775, Unionen: Ingrid Nilsson    +46 21 32 14 66, Frank Hollstedt    +46 10 7387043. All other questions can be directed to our Talent Acquisition Partner Filip Henriksson (filip.henriksson@hitachienergy.com).
Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, enabling a sustainable energy future through innovative power grid technologies with digitalization at the core. More than three billion people rely on our technologies every day. With over a century of pioneering expertise in high voltage, transformers, automation, and power electronics, we are addressing one of the world’s most critical challenges—meeting growing electricity demand while decarbonizing the power system. Headquartered in Switzerland, Hitachi Energy employs over 50,000 people in 60 countries and generates revenues of approximately USD 16 billion.

The opportunity  
We are expanding and looking for a Senior Project Engineer to join our growing global team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, engineering, and delivery of climate systems within HVDC projects, ensuring the reliable operation of HVDC stations around the world, from deserts to arctic regions, both onshore and offshore. 
 
“At Hitachi Energy, the Climate System team plays a key role in ensuring the reliability and performance of HVDC stations across the globe. We are building a strong, multidisciplinary organization that combines deep technical competence with collaboration and innovation. As a Senior Project Engineer, you’ll be part of this journey. If you are motivated by engineering excellence and global impact, we would be happy to welcome you to our team” - Farshad Abbasi, Manager Climate System 
 This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 

How you’ll make an impact 
Perform the technical design and calculations of climate systems for HVDC converter stations, including reviewing designs, drawings, documentation, and technical specifications. 
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure effective integration of climate systems within overall HVDC plant designs. 
Support all project phases—from tendering and conceptual design to detailed engineering, procurement, installation, and commissioning—ensuring quality and timely execution. 
Conduct design reviews to ensure compliance with customer requirements, ASHRAE standards, and internal guidelines. 
Assist with testing, verification, and performance validation during commissioning, including site inspections and on-site support. 
Translate customer needs into reliable and compliant climate system solutions. 
Contribute to continuous improvement efforts and mentor junior engineers to support technical development within the team. 

Your background 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Energy Systems, or a related field with a focus on heat transfer and fluid mechanics. 
Proven expertise in climate systems or HVAC equipment such as chillers, dehumidifiers, air handling units, and integrated monitoring and control sensors. 
Solid understanding of psychrometric charts, heat transfer (active/passive), flow diagrams, and control systems. 
Experience working on large-scale engineering projects is an advantage. 
You should ideally like working in a multicultural environment and be able to express yourself written and spoken in English. Swedish is considered an advantage. 

 
More about us  
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​  
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ 
Psychological support program​​ 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​ 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​ 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​ 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​ 

 
The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

This position is a temporary role between January 17th, 2027 and July 16th, 2027, and will be an onsite role based in Uppsala, Sweden.

Plan, perform and evaluate Extractables & Leachables (E&L) analyses for new and existing products using relevant analytical techniques.
Perform analytical testing using GC-MS and other applicable analytical methods, including interpretation, evaluation and documentation of results.
Develop, optimise and troubleshoot analytical methods to meet project and product requirements.

Hands-on experience with laboratory work, including sample preparation, analysis and interpretation of analytical data.
Fluency in English.

Hands-on experience working with GC-MS.
Extractables & Leachables (E&L) testing, including analysis of materials used in life science, pharmaceutical or medical-device applications.
Working in a QC, regulated or quality-controlled laboratory environment.
Additional analytical techniques relevant to characterisation of organic compounds.

To be successful in this role, the ideal candidate should be a highly quality-oriented individual with an analytical mindset. jobs.occupation: IT Procurement Consultant / Software Asset Manager
jobs.description:
IT Procurement Consultant / Software Asset Manager – Stockholm or Gothenburg🚀 About the Role
We are looking for an experienced IT Procurement Consultant or Software Asset Manager for an exciting consulting assignment focused on strategic IT sourcing, supplier management, and digital transformation.
In this role, you will play a key part in a major digital transformation programme, supporting strategic sourcing and procurement activities across IT and Operational Technology (OT).
You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT, architecture, information security, legal, and procurement teams to ensure effective sourcing strategies, well-informed supplier decisions, and sustainable commercial solutions.
This opportunity is ideal for someone with extensive experience in IT procurement or Software Asset Management who combines strong commercial awareness with analytical thinking and a results-oriented approach.
💼 Key Responsibilities
Conduct IT/OT category assessments and supplier market analyses to identify relevant services, capabilities, and potential suppliers.

Translate business, technical, architectural, security, and transition requirements into sourcing strategies and procurement plans.

Prepare, coordinate, and manage RFI, RFQ, and RFP processes.

Plan and monitor procurement milestones, dependencies, and key decisions.

Develop supplier evaluation criteria, commercial models, and scoring frameworks.

Coordinate supplier evaluations, shortlisting, clarification meetings, and negotiations.

Support contract negotiations, supplier onboarding, mobilisation, and handover activities.

Monitor supplier selection progress, timelines, commercial assumptions, risks, and decisions.

Provide procurement-related insights and recommendations for budget discussions, reporting, and steering committee decisions.

Ensure procurement activities align with governance, compliance, and programme objectives.

✅ Requirements
We are looking for someone who meets the following criteria:

At least 5 years of experience as a Procurement Consultant with a strong focus on software sourcing within IT, or at least 5 years of experience as a Software Asset Manager in large corporations.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to align commercial, technical, and business perspectives.

Strong analytical and organisational skills, with experience managing complex procurement activities and decision-making processes.

Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively, and maintain progress in dynamic environments.

Experience ensuring procurement quality, governance, compliance, and transparency.

Strong stakeholder management skills and experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.

High integrity and sound judgement when handling commercially sensitive and confidential information.

A relevant university or college degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, IT, or equivalent professional experience.

🌟 Personal Qualities
To succeed in this role, you are commercially minded, analytical, structured, and proactive.
You are confident communicating with both technical specialists and senior decision-makers, and you have the ability to build trust, challenge constructively, and drive procurement activities forward.
You thrive in complex organisations, enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders, and can balance strategic priorities with operational delivery.
📍 Assignment Details
Location: Solna (Stockholm) or Gothenburg, Sweden

Start date: 9 November 2026

End date: 30 April 2027

Please note that your CV must be submitted in English.

Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.
Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.
